description: A cross-platform dropdown selector for React Native. Supports iOS, Android, Web, and Windows with customizable items, styles, and programmatic control.

androidProgrammaticControl.description: Open/close the Picker programmatically (Android only, v1.16.0+).

selectedValue.description: Value matching the value of one of the Picker items.

onValueChange.description: Callback invoked when an item is selected.

style.description: Custom style for the Picker component.

testID.description: Used to locate this view in end-to-end tests.

enabled.description: Whether the Picker is enabled or disabled (Android, Web, Windows).

mode.description: Android only: defines how the Picker items are displayed.

dropdownIconColor.description: Android only: color of the dropdown triangle.

dropdownIconRippleColor.description: Android only: ripple color of the dropdown triangle.

prompt.description: Android only: title shown when Picker is in dialog mode.

itemStyle.description: Custom style for Picker items (iOS, Windows).

numberOfLines.description: Maximum number of lines for Picker items (Android & iOS).

onBlur.description: Android only: invoked when Picker loses focus.

onFocus.description: Android only: invoked when Picker gains focus.

selectionColor.description: iOS only: color of the selection highlight.

label.description: Text displayed for this Picker item.

value.description: Value assigned to this Picker item.

color.description: Text color of the Picker item.

fontFamily.description: Font family for the Picker item.

style.description: Android only: style for the item label.

enabled.description: Android only: whether the item is selectable.

contentDescription.description: Android only: content description for accessibility.

notes: Supports programmatic open/close on Android using `ref`.
Customizable per-item styles and selection colors.
Picker.Item is required for each selectable option.
